name: agent-strace
description: Capture and investigate OpenAI Codex agent sessions with local AgentTrace hooks and a reusable skill.

interface.shortDescription: Record Codex sessions locally, then replay, explain, lint, and cost them with agent-strace.
interface.longDescription: AgentTrace adds Codex lifecycle hooks that record prompts, tool calls, subagents, and session ends to .agent-traces/ in the project, plus a skill that replays, explains, lints, audits, and prices recorded sessions. It needs the agent-strace Python package on PATH. Review and trust the hooks in /hooks before they run.
defaultPrompt: List my recent agent-strace sessions and summarize the latest one.
Explain why the last Codex session failed.
How much did the latest session cost?
